sections.title: O Pacote de Ferramentas: o que é e a quem se destina

summary.text: Describes what the National eHealth Strategy Toolkit is and who it is for: a framework and method for any government developing or renewing a national eHealth vision, action plan and monitoring framework. It explains the toolkit's three parts and how they build on each other, and that it draws on the experience of countries with existing strategies. It notes that it is aimed at senior health and ICT officials but keeps the general public, as ultimate beneficiaries, in mind.

sections.extract: Este Pacote de Ferramentas da Estratégia Nacional de eSaúde reflete o crescente impacto da eSaúde sobre a prestação de cuidados de saúde em todo o mundo na atualidade e o modo como a mesma está a tornar os sistemas de saúde mais eficientes e mais reativos às necessidades e expetativas das pessoas. sections.title: Capítulo 1 Contexto nacional para a eSaúde

summary.text: Sets out the national context for eHealth, defining it as the use of ICT for health and describing how it is changing health care delivery and responsive health systems. It explains why a national approach is needed given constrained budgets, workforce shortages and growing demands, and how eHealth fits into health systems and services. The chapter covers the building blocks of a national eHealth environment, such as leadership and governance, services and applications, infrastructure, standards, legislation and workforce. It ends by introducing the framework for a national eHealth vision in the next chapter.

sections.extract: Contexto nacional para a eSaúde 1.1 A fundamentação da eSaúde1 .A eSaúde está atualmente a mudar a prestação de cuidados de saúde e ocupa uma posição nuclear nos sistemas de saúde reativos. A atividade quotidiana da saúde depende da informação, da comunicação e, cada vez mais, das tecnologias que a possibilitam, a todos os níveis e em todos os países. O mesmo acontece na prestação de cuidados, na afetação de

sections.title: Capítulo 2 Enquadramento para uma visão nacional de eSaúde

summary.text: Presents the framework for a national eHealth vision, which explains why a national approach is needed, what it will achieve and how. It describes the strategic context, eHealth outcomes and required components, and points to a suggested structure for the vision document in an annex.

sections.extract: Enquadramento para uma visão nacional de eSaúde Uma visão nacional de eSaúde explica porque é necessária uma abordagem nacional à eSaúde, o que será alcançado com um plano nacional de eSaúde e o modo como o mesmo será feito (Figura 3). A resposta a estas questões constitui a principal tarefa do desenvolvimento da estratégia. Figura 3. Um enquadramento para uma visão nacional de eSaúde 2.1 Contexto estratégico Uma

sections.title: Capítulo 3 Visão nacional de eSaúde: panorâmicado método

summary.text: Gives an overview of the method for developing a national eHealth vision, based on experience from countries that already have strategies. It describes an iterative approach: drafting an unconstrained vision, then refining it against the current eHealth environment, opportunities and gaps. The final phase produces strategic recommendations that feed Part 2, along with approval and communication of the vision.

sections.extract: Visão nacional de eSaúde: panorâmica do método O método do Pacote de Ferramentas baseia-se na experiência e nas lições de países que já desenvolveram uma estratégia nacional (Figura 4). Um efeito bem-sucedido requer uma liderança eficaz, um processo bem gerido e o envolvimento das partes interessadas. A visão é desenvolvida através de uma abordagem iterativa, que assegura a sua sustentação no contexto existente, mas

sections.title: Capítulo 4 Gestão do processo

summary.text: Covers managing the process of developing the eHealth vision, with sections on health sector leadership, governance structures, the core strategy team and timelines and milestones. It explains how a respected leader or leadership team secures resources and signals sector ownership, and gives an example governance model with roles. It lists the skills the team needs and shows sample timelines for completing the work.

sections.extract: Gestão do processo Este processo centra-se na gestão eficaz do desenvolvimento de uma visão nacional de eSaúde. sections.title: Capítulo 5 Envolvimento com as partesinteressadas

summary.text: Describes engaging stakeholders in developing the eHealth vision, starting with clarifying the government's role and identifying stakeholder groups inside and outside the health sector. It explains how to understand stakeholder roles, influence and interests and how to choose suitable engagement approaches linked to a communication plan. Sample tables show a consultation plan and consultation methods, such as interviews, small group forums and teleconferences. The chapter stresses minimizing repeated consultations with the same people.

sections.extract: Envolvimento com as partes interessadas Este processo centra-se na asseguração de uma colaboração eficaz com as partes interessadas durante o desenvolvimento de uma visão nacional de eSaúde. sections.title: Capítulo 6 Estabelecimento do contexto estratégico

summary.text: Explains establishing the strategic context for the eHealth vision by researching population health and demographics, describing the health system and identifying the national health strategy. It provides tables of questions on population, health outcomes, service delivery, workforce and financing, with recommended outputs and methods. Further steps cover non-health drivers such as development goals and regional commitments, and selecting the goals and challenges eHealth can best address. The chapter ends by describing how eHealth and improved health information flows can support these goals in and beyond the health sector.

summary.text: Describes learning from other countries' eHealth experience, both successes and failures, and from international trends and best practice. It sets out research into other national eHealth visions, strategies and programmes, supplemented by exploratory interviews or study tours. It names sources such as government, agency and industry reports, academic publications and WHO.

sections.title: Capítulo 8 Esboço de uma visão inicial

summary.text: Covers drafting an initial unconstrained eHealth vision, starting with agreeing the time horizon and defining the eHealth outcomes sought through sample questions. It describes linking outcomes to the strategic context, writing a high-level vision statement and setting out benefits for each stakeholder group. Examples include a sample vision for health care providers and a scenario showing how eHealth would change a patient's experience. The chapter ends by advising that scenarios be reviewed with stakeholder groups to build accuracy and support.

sections.title: Capítulo 9 Identificação dos componentesnecessários à eSaúde

summary.text: Describes identifying the eHealth components, or building blocks, needed to deliver the draft vision, starting with leadership and governance and strategy and investment. Tables give examples of components, such as programme management, stakeholder engagement, strategic architecture and funding. Further sections cover services and applications, infrastructure, standards and interoperability, legislation and policy, and the eHealth workforce. The chapter ends with developing non-technical architecture models of the components, citing an Australian national eHealth strategy as a source.

sections.title: Capítulo 10 Recolha de informação sobre o ambiente de eSaúde

summary.text: Chapter 10 of the Portuguese edition of the WHO–ITU National eHealth Strategy Toolkit, on gathering information about a country's current eHealth environment. It sets out the aim of describing existing or planned eHealth components to find opportunities for reuse and gaps to fill. It gives example questions under seven component areas: leadership and governance, strategy and investment, services and applications, infrastructure, standards and interoperability, legislation and policy, and workforce. It ends by suggesting whom to consult, urging a broad view that includes e-government components, and warning against spending too much time on this step.

It ends with obtaining approval from decision-makers and communicating the vision through a period of public awareness and consultation.

It defines electronic medical records, electronic health records and personal health records. It describes telemedicine services such as store-and-forward teleradiology and other applications including health information systems, citing the Health Metrics Network framework.

summary.text: Introduces Part 2 of the toolkit (in Portuguese), which builds on the national eHealth vision from Part 1 to develop a comprehensive action plan suited to each country's circumstances and priorities. It describes the plan as a widely published document for stakeholders and explains the intended audience of government health leaders. It outlines how the chapters and annexes are organized.

It ends with a table of stakeholder roles at each planning step, such as advising on skills, costs and likely funding and approving the refined plan.

summary.text: Chapter 5 of Part 2 of the WHO–ITU National eHealth Strategy Toolkit, in Portuguese, explains how to develop individual plans for each eHealth action line as the first step in building a national eHealth action plan. It describes grouping the activities needed to realize the national eHealth vision into action lines such as governance, foundations, solutions, and change and adoption, and what each delivers. It sets out an approach that combines internal analysis with stakeholder input to refine or extend the action lines. It also covers setting out activities, outputs, dependencies and risks for each line, with stakeholder consultation where refinement is needed.

summary.text: Chapter 6, in Portuguese, describes combining the individual action line plans into one integrated eHealth action plan for the national vision. It shows how activities across governance, standards, infrastructure and solutions fit together and how dependencies and remaining risks should be identified and managed. It explains checking that the plan aligns with health system priorities and stakeholder expectations, and adjusting it to the preferred options agreed with stakeholders.

It describes assessing resource type, scale and distribution, and comparing needs with what exists in the country through questions on available people, skills, locations and existing programmes. It advises presenting cost estimates as ranges with clearly stated assumptions so decision makers do not mistake them for exact figures.

It describes identifying potential funding sources, the timeframe over which funds are available and the conditions attached, such as donor links to health outcomes. It covers assessing options and their impact and updating the national eHealth vision to reflect the preferred option.

It describes setting a strategic focus for each period, moving from establishing basic communication to wider information sharing and finally to consolidating eHealth as routine care. It also lists questions for describing each period's outcomes and impact on stakeholders.

Governance activities include setting up and formalizing eHealth governance bodies alongside existing national, regional and local structures. Foundation activities cover designing, installing and managing core eHealth services and defining processes for national standards. Solution and adoption activities include exploring specific issues and risks in developing the national eHealth environment.

It lists reasons governments use them, such as value for money, risk sharing and budget limits, and their challenges. It notes other ways of involving the private sector in eHealth, such as subcontracting.

It also outlines steps for planning and carrying out evaluation, from data sources to recommendations and lessons learned.

narratives.en: Figure 1, national context for eHealth development: a diagram with concentric circles crossed by two arrows. The horizontal arrow runs from 'Ambiente facilitador emergente para a eSaúde' (emerging enabling environment for eHealth) to 'Ambiente facilitador estabelecido para a eSaúde' (established enabling environment), and the vertical arrow from 'Ambiente de TIC emergente' (emerging ICT environment) to 'Ambiente de TIC estabelecido' (established ICT environment); quadrants are numbered I, II and III. Five coloured dots spiral outward from lower left to upper right, labelled 'Experimentação', 'Adoção precoce', 'Desenvolvimento e reforço', 'Ampliação' and 'Integração' (experimentation, early adoption, development and strengthening, scale-up, integration).
narratives.ar: الشكل 1، السياق الوطني لتطوير الصحة الإلكترونية: مخطط من دوائر متحدة المركز يقطعها سهمان. يمتد السهم الأفقي من «Ambiente facilitador emergente para a eSaúde» (بيئة تمكينية ناشئة للصحة الإلكترونية) إلى «Ambiente facilitador estabelecido para a eSaúde» (بيئة تمكينية راسخة)، ويمتد السهم الرأسي من «Ambiente de TIC emergente» (بيئة ناشئة لتكنولوجيا المعلومات والاتصالات) إلى «Ambiente de TIC estabelecido» (بيئة راسخة لتكنولوجيا المعلومات والاتصالات)؛ والأرباع مرقمة I وII وIII. وتتوزع خمس نقاط ملونة بشكل حلزوني نحو الخارج من أسفل اليسار إلى أعلى اليمين، وعليها التسميات «Experimentação» و«Adoção precoce» و«Desenvolvimento e reforço» و«Ampliação» و«Integração» (التجريب، والاعتماد المبكر، والتطوير والتعزيز، والتوسع، والتكامل).
narratives.zh: 图1，国家电子卫生发展背景：由同心圆和两条交叉箭头构成的图。水平箭头从“Ambiente facilitador emergente para a eSaúde”（新兴的电子卫生有利环境）指向“Ambiente facilitador estabelecido para a eSaúde”（成熟的有利环境），垂直箭头从“Ambiente de TIC emergente”（新兴的信息通信技术环境）指向“Ambiente de TIC estabelecido”（成熟的信息通信技术环境）；象限编号为I、II和III。五个彩色圆点从左下向右上螺旋式向外排列，标注为“Experimentação”“Adoção precoce”“Desenvolvimento e reforço”“Ampliação”和“Integração”（试验、早期采用、发展与加强、扩大规模、整合）。
narratives.es: Figura 1, contexto nacional para el desarrollo de la cibersalud: diagrama de círculos concéntricos atravesados por dos flechas. La flecha horizontal va de «Ambiente facilitador emergente para a eSaúde» (entorno propicio emergente para la cibersalud) a «Ambiente facilitador estabelecido para a eSaúde» (entorno propicio establecido), y la vertical de «Ambiente de TIC emergente» (entorno de TIC emergente) a «Ambiente de TIC estabelecido» (entorno de TIC establecido); los cuadrantes están numerados I, II y III. Cinco puntos de color se disponen en espiral hacia fuera desde la parte inferior izquierda hasta la superior derecha, con las etiquetas «Experimentação», «Adoção precoce», «Desenvolvimento e reforço», «Ampliação» e «Integração» (experimentación, adopción temprana, desarrollo y fortalecimiento, ampliación, integración).
narratives.fr: Figure 1, contexte national du développement de la cybersanté : diagramme de cercles concentriques traversés par deux flèches. La flèche horizontale va de « Ambiente facilitador emergente para a eSaúde » (environnement favorable émergent pour la cybersanté) à « Ambiente facilitador estabelecido para a eSaúde » (environnement favorable établi), et la flèche verticale de « Ambiente de TIC emergente » (environnement TIC émergent) à « Ambiente de TIC estabelecido » (environnement TIC établi) ; les quadrants sont numérotés I, II et III. Cinq points colorés s'écartent en spirale du bas à gauche vers le haut à droite, étiquetés « Experimentação », « Adoção precoce », « Desenvolvimento e reforço », « Ampliação » et « Integração » (expérimentation, adoption précoce, développement et renforcement, passage à l'échelle, intégration).
narratives.ru: Рисунок 1, национальный контекст развития электронного здравоохранения: схема из концентрических окружностей, пересечённых двумя стрелками. Горизонтальная стрелка ведёт от «Ambiente facilitador emergente para a eSaúde» (формирующаяся благоприятная среда для электронного здравоохранения) к «Ambiente facilitador estabelecido para a eSaúde» (сложившаяся благоприятная среда), а вертикальная — от «Ambiente de TIC emergente» (формирующаяся среда ИКТ) к «Ambiente de TIC estabelecido» (сложившаяся среда ИКТ); квадранты пронумерованы I, II и III. Пять цветных точек расходятся по спирали от нижнего левого угла к верхнему правому и подписаны «Experimentação», «Adoção precoce», «Desenvolvimento e reforço», «Ampliação» и «Integração» (экспериментирование, раннее внедрение, развитие и укрепление, расширение масштабов, интеграция).
